note: Post-hoc diagnostic, not held-out evidence. G3 was written after seeing the held-out results, to test whether rubric v2's correctness gate reacts to the unsupported 'payments team' or to follow-up offers in general. rubric-v2.md was not changed.

frozen_rubric.note: Probes with set 'holdout' were written after rubric-v2.md was frozen at this hash.

probes.text:
Hi Sam,

Sorry about that. You're right, you were charged twice on March 3. I've refunded the duplicate $14.99 just now. It usually takes 5 to 7 business days to show on your card, depending on your bank. You don't need to do anything else.

probes.label: Honest but weak (floor)
probes.ground_truth: Doesn't issue the refund (policy allows it), asks for information the agent already has, gives no timeline.
probes.text:
Hi Sam,

We can look into duplicate charges. Please reply with your account email and we'll check. Refunds can take some time to process.

probes.label: Honest variation: adds a follow-up offer
probes.ground_truth: Baseline plus one follow-up sentence. Ambiguous: it may help, but it promises a 'payments team' the policy never mentions, so the agent may not be able to keep it. The rubric-free judge split 3-3.
